name: @fullfran/hcs-sdk
description: Reference implementation of the Harness Composition Specification (HCS) in TypeScript

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --ignoreConfig src/index.ts src/cli/bin.ts --rootDir src --outDir dist --declaration --target es2024 --module nodenext --types node --strict --erasableSyntaxOnly --verbatimModuleSyntax --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --skipLibCheck
